top_signals.title: How Do Europe's Companies Regain Their Edge?
top_signals.summary: Europe's industrial companies are under growing pressure from high energy and labor costs, weakening investment and intensifying global competition. McKinsey research finds that 45% of European industrial companies are showing signs of financial stress or distress but argues that the decline is not inevitable. Tunde Olanrewaju, Managing Partner for Europe at McKinsey & Company, joins Bloomberg Radio's Ben Boulos and Charles Capel to discuss what is driving Europe's industrial competitiveness challenge and the turnaround strategies that could help companies fight back. (Source: Bloomberg)
